resources.string: No one is here yet. A helper can add people in Settings.
Calls aren\'t allowed yet. Tap a face, then choose Allow.
Calls are turned off for Niko Dialer. A helper can turn them on in the phone\'s settings.
The call didn\'t start. Try again in a moment.
Calls from unsaved numbers ring again. A helper can fix this in Settings.
Calls may stop working later. A helper can fix this in Settings.
How many faces the main screen has room for. Nobody moves when this changes. People who don\'t fit come back when there is room again.
After a face is tapped, the name is spoken. Wait 3 seconds leaves time to press Stop before the call goes out. Ask first shows a big Call button to press.
A 4-number PIN stops people and settings being changed by accident. Calling always works without it.
Go through the main settings again
Some phones stop apps they think are unused and take their permissions away. That can stop calls. Keep Niko Dialer allowed in the phone maker\'s settings.
Calls from unsaved numbers ring again. Allow %1$s to silence them.
Calls from people not saved in the phone won\'t ring. They still show as missed calls.

Calls from numbers that aren\'t saved in the phone\'s contacts don\'t ring. They still show as missed calls, so a call from a clinic isn\'t lost. The phone decides who is saved, using all its contacts, not just the people in Niko Dialer. Hidden numbers don\'t ring either.
Off. This needs Android 10 or newer.
Off. This phone doesn\'t let apps silence calls.
Not turned on. The phone didn\'t allow Niko Dialer to silence calls. Tap to try again.

If the phone didn't ask, or said the setting is restricted:
1. Tap Open app info below.
2. Tap the three dots at the top.
3. Tap Allow restricted settings.
4. Come back here and turn this on again.
The phone\'s page for Niko Dialer
When a call from a number not saved in the phone last came in without ringing. Only the time is kept, not the number. The phone\'s missed calls show who it was.
Add a name, so it can be shown and spoken.
Add a phone number to call.
This is an emergency number. Tapping the face opens the phone\'s dialer with the number ready, because Android doesn\'t let other apps call it directly.
That place has someone in it now. Choose another place.
That contact couldn\'t be read. Try again, or type the name and number.
This phone has no contacts app to choose from. Type the name and number instead.
Niko Dialer also saves %1$s in the phone\'s contacts, on the phone, not the SIM. Then a recorded name can play when %1$s calls, and Only ring for saved contacts lets the call ring.

Niko Dialer also saves %1$s in the phone\'s contacts, on the phone, not the SIM. Then a recorded name can play when %1$s calls, and Only ring for saved contacts lets the call ring. After Save, the phone asks to allow contacts.
%1$s is saved on the SIM card. A SIM contact can\'t have its own ringtone, so a recorded name can\'t play when %1$s calls. Copy %1$s to the phone to fix this.
%1$s is saved on the phone now.
%1$s couldn\'t be copied to the phone. Try again.
Copying needs the phone\'s contacts. Tap Copy to the phone, then choose Allow.

%1$s is in Niko Dialer, but not in the phone\'s contacts. A recorded name can only play when %1$s calls if they are in the contacts. Only ring for saved contacts may also keep their calls quiet. To change this, open %1$s again, tap Save and choose Allow.
A photo helps. A face is easier to find than a name.
That photo couldn\'t be opened. Try another one.
This phone has no camera app to take a photo with. Choose a photo instead.
This phone has no app to choose a photo from. Take a photo instead.
When %1$s calls, the phone plays this instead of the ringtone. Tap Record and say \"%1$s is calling\" in your own words and language. It stops by itself after 5 seconds.
The recording shows in the phone\'s ringtone list, and stays on the phone if Niko Dialer is uninstalled.
Recorded. Tap Play to hear it.
Recorded. It is kept when you tap Save.
The recording goes when you tap Save.
Recording. Say the words, then tap Stop.
Nothing was recorded. Tap Record, wait a moment, then speak.
The microphone couldn\'t be used. Close other apps that may be using it, then try again.
Recording needs the microphone. Tap Record, then choose Allow.
The microphone is turned off for Niko Dialer. Turn it on in the phone\'s settings for Niko Dialer.
The recording is kept, but it can\'t ring for %1$s until contacts are allowed.
The recording is kept, but it can\'t go in the phone\'s ringtones until storage is allowed.
The phone asks to allow the microphone, to record.
It asks for contacts, to set the recording as the ringtone for %1$s.
It asks for storage, to put the recording with the phone\'s ringtones.
Fit the face in the square
The photo as it will look on the face
Drag the photo to move it, and pinch to zoom. The buttons do the same.
The photo couldn\'t be saved. Try again.
Tap a place to add someone to it.
A photo helps. A face is easier to find than a name. These people have no photo yet.
Niko Dialer needs to be allowed to make phone calls, so a tap on a face starts the call.
Not allowed yet. Tap to allow.
Turned off. Tap to open the phone\'s settings for Niko Dialer.
Calls from strangers can be kept quiet, so only people saved in the phone ring. The phone asks once to let Niko Dialer silence calls. This can be changed later in Settings.
If the phone has two SIMs, choose one for calls, so the phone doesn\'t ask which one each time.
